cs.t: - Apple Magic Touchpad. I used to use a wired mouse and the flexibility of a wireless touchpad (and gesture support) is much nicer. - Dyson V7 Vacuum. Having a wireless vacuum has been great. - Motobecane Gravel X-PRO HD (gravel bike). I'd never heard of a gravel bike until it was recommended to me, but I've gotten a ton of use out of it.
